page.overview:
Who is Cheep Cheep?

Cheep Cheep is a character in Mario Party Advance. He is a representative of his species of the same name and has the same physical appearance as them.

Cheep Cheep practices his swimming at the Mushroom Pool, although he has a lack of confidence in his ability to swim. For the Swimmin' Wimp quest, Coach asks for the player's character to swim against Cheep Cheep in a race and deliberately lose by a short margin while still investing some effort. If done successfully, Cheep Cheep has a large surge in confidence, happily telling Coach that he won. As a reward, Coach gives the player a Desktop Golf Gaddget.

At Sushi Cliff, Cheep Cheep was one of three witnesses who saw Shroomlock being pulled off the cliff and into the ocean, the other two being Blooper and Dolphin. Blooper is revealed to be the real culprit due to having tentacles, which neither Cheep Cheep nor Dolphin have (or any sort of arms).
